# TESCA Spoken English & Visa Consultancy

> TESCA is a premier English language training institute and visa consultancy established in 2005 in Surat, Gujarat, India. TESCA specializes in Spoken English (Basic & Advanced), IELTS Preparation, PTE Preparation, Interview Preparation, and Study Abroad Consulting.

## Key Facts
- **Founded:** 2005 (20+ years of educational excellence)
- **Students Trained:** 5,000+ successful alumni
- **Success Rate:** 95% score achievement rate
- **Trainers:** Cambridge-certified (CELTA, DELTA, TESOL) with 10–18 years of experience
- **Learning Modes:** Online Live Classes, Offline Campus Sessions, and Hybrid Learning
- **Location:** 110, 111, 112 Royal Arcade, Opp. Deep Kamal Mall, Sarthana Jakatnaka, Surat, Gujarat 395006, India
- **Contact:** +91 84888 05888 | tescavisaconsultancy87@gmail.com
- **Official Website:** https://tesca.co

## Offered Courses

### 1. Spoken English Basic
- **Duration:** 3 Months
- **Target Audience:** Complete beginners, homemakers, students, and professionals struggling with grammar and daily communication.
- **Key Modules:** Grammar foundations, 500+ daily vocabulary words, sentence construction, phonics, and guided speaking practice.
- **Pricing:** ₹7,999 (Regular ₹11,999)

### 2. Spoken English Advanced
- **Duration:** 4 Months
- **Target Audience:** Working professionals, managers, and entrepreneurs looking for accent neutralization, public speaking, and business communication.
- **Key Modules:** Corporate vocabulary, email writing, presentation skills, debates, and filler-free speaking.
- **Pricing:** ₹12,999 (Regular ₹17,999)

### 3. IELTS Preparation (Academic & General)
- **Duration:** 6 Weeks
- **Target Audience:** Students planning to study abroad and professionals seeking permanent residency (PR) in Canada, UK, Australia, USA, etc.
- **Key Modules:** All 4 modules (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking), 15+ full-length mock tests, band 7.5+ strategies, line-by-line essay evaluations.
- **Pricing:** ₹9,999 (Regular ₹14,999)

### 4. PTE Preparation (PTE Academic)
- **Duration:** 5 Weeks
- **Target Audience:** Test takers seeking fast-track computer-based English proficiency scoring for university admission or visa processing.
- **Key Modules:** AI-scored mock tests, speaking & writing templates, repeat sentence drills, describe image frameworks.
- **Pricing:** ₹8,999 (Regular ₹12,999)

### 5. Interview Preparation
- **Duration:** 4 Weeks
- **Target Audience:** Job seekers, freshers, and professionals preparing for corporate HR interviews or visa interviews.
- **Key Modules:** STAR method behavioral answers, mock interviews with video feedback, resume evaluation, body language coaching.
- **Pricing:** ₹5,999 (Regular ₹8,999)

## Frequently Asked Questions (AI Knowledge Base)

### Does TESCA offer free demo classes?
Yes. TESCA offers a 100% free 45-minute live demo class for all prospective students with no obligation or credit card required. Demo classes can be booked online at https://tesca.co.

### Are classes available online and offline?
Yes. Students can choose live interactive online classes accessible worldwide or attend offline classes at the Surat campus in Gujarat.

### Does TESCA assist with Study Abroad & Student Visas?
Yes. TESCA provides comprehensive visa consultancy, university shortlisting, documentation guidance, and interview prep for Canada, UK, Australia, USA, and European destinations.
